text:
maria_sec: Quick q — planning RBAC change for tenant boundary in private deploys. Want to allow a scoped 'keystore-read' SA for model-serving nodes so they can fetch wrapped keys during startup. Concerns: auditability and rollback if we rotate keys.

sam_infra: +1, we need to ensure the SA can't call decrypt on arbitrary resources. Proposal: grant kms.decrypt only on resource path projects/redwood-priv/locations/*/keyRings/tenant-*/cryptoKeys/serve-key

jess_ops: How will we capture keystore access in the audit logs? Onprem customers want at least 90d retention and push to SIEM.

aditya_sre: We can emit audit logs to local syslog-forwarder and ship to splunk. Need to add structured fields: tenant_id, pod_name, sa_email, request_payload_hash. Also add "keystore_action" tag.

maria_sec: @aditya_sre can you draft the log schema? Also need to ensure netpols block egress except to KMS endpoints + NTP/CDN.

aditya_sre: sketch below — thoughts?

```
# keystore audit schema (json)
{
  "timestamp": "ISO8601",
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "pod": "string",
  "service_account": "string",
  "action": "decrypt|encrypt|get|list",
  "resource": "projects/.../cryptoKeys/...",
  "request_hash": "sha256",
  "outcome": "success|fail",
  "error_code": "string?"
}
```

sam_infra: network policy draft — allow egress only to kms FQNs and internal logging endpoint.

```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-keystore-egress
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: model-serving
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          infra: keystore-proxy
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.200.50.0/24
        except: [10.200.50.128/25]
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

jess_ops: For KMS integration, customers running airgapped onprem ask about HSMs. We should document fallback: local sealed-key decryptor that uses an HSM-backed key when available, otherwise fail closed.

olivia_research: FYI we saw a regression during staged keystore rotation in canary — vault agent timed out once on 30s window, caused service retry storms. Suggest backoff + circuit breaker.

maria_sec: Good catch. Add canary test: rotate a test key and run 100 parallel restarts, measure 99th pct latency and error rate. If >1% errors, abort rotation.

deploy-bot: deploy 17985 -> infra/keystore-proxy v1.12 initiated by sam_infra

sam_infra: Heads-up: will open a narrow RBAC PR granting iam.serviceAccounts.get to monitoring SA so audit export can stamp sa_email. Minimal scope.

aditya_sre: Also adding a short-lived audit-hint header so logs can correlate key rotation requests vs deploy IDs.

jess_ops: Anything on vulnerability triage? We found a dependency with CVE-2026-0456 in keystore proxy. Patch is upstream 1.2.3.

maria_sec: Timeline? If exploit requires SA tokens, we treat as high. @sam_infra prioritize upgrading proxy image and schedule hotfix for customer clusters.

sam_infra: Will cut hotfix branch and coordinate with olivia for canary.ETA 3 hours.

olivia_research: I'll run the rotation sim once the hotfix is in canary.

maria_sec: Great. Also doc ask: create a short runbook section for 'keystore access incident' — steps: 1) rotate affected keys, 2) revoke SA tokens, 3) push audit exports to sec-sandbox, 4) contact customer success. Keep it short.

jess_ops: I'll draft runbook and retention policy note. :thumbsup:

aditya_sre: Adding a Grafana panel for 'keystore decrypt latency' and 'decrypt error rate by tenant'.

maria_sec: Thanks all — let's reconvene if canary shows any blips. Filing follow-up ticket: INFSEC-7291
